name: WTQ Pool
description: 把本机 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 的桌面登录接入 PI-Desktop。限流或额度用尽时自动换号，三家各有开关。
author: chengzhi-c (PI-Desktop port of XDTrees/dsh-workbuddy-xdpool)

en.name: WTQ Pool
en.description: Bring this machine's WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder desktop sign-ins into PI-Desktop. An account that is rate-limited or out of credits fails over to the next one, and each source has its own switch.
en.safetyNotes: Reads the WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder sign-ins already saved on this machine. An account can also be signed in from the panel; that credential is stored only under the plugin's own data directory, and the panel can delete such an account again, removing the sign-in file and its archived copy together; a desktop snapshot of that account is no longer taken over, and signing in again brings it back. When an installation is not in its default location, only its uninstall registry entry is read to locate it. Keys for encrypted fields stay in memory. Tokens are sent only to each vendor's own hosts: copilot.tencent.com / www.codebuddy.cn / www.codebuddy.ai / www.workbuddy.ai, api.trae.cn / solo.trae.cn / trae-api-cn.mchost.guru / coresg-normal.trae.ai / growsg-normal.trae.ai, gateway.qoder.com.cn / openapi.qoder.com.cn / api3.qoder.sh / openapi.qoder.sh. Chat is served from an endpoint on 127.0.0.1.

zh-CN.name: WTQ Pool
zh-CN.description: 把本机 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 的桌面登录接入 PI-Desktop。限流或额度用尽时自动换号，三家各有开关。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 只读本机 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 已保存的登录。也可以从面板登录账号，该凭证只写在插件自管数据目录内；面板可将这类账号连同登录文件与留档一并删除，桌面端遗留的同一份快照不再被接管，重新登录该账号即可回来。安装目录不在默认位置时，仅读取卸载项来定位。加密字段的密钥只保留在内存中。令牌只发往各家自己的接口：copilot.tencent.com / www.codebuddy.cn / www.codebuddy.ai / www.workbuddy.ai、api.trae.cn / solo.trae.cn / trae-api-cn.mchost.guru / coresg-normal.trae.ai / growsg-normal.trae.ai、gateway.qoder.com.cn / openapi.qoder.com.cn / api3.qoder.sh / openapi.qoder.sh。对话由本机 127.0.0.1 上的端点转发。
